case01.mail.nova.subject: Security alert: €14,500 card purchase
case01.mail.nova.preview: Was this purchase yours? Review the transaction.
case01.mail.nova.body:
Dear customer,

Our risk control department detected an unusual card purchase of €14,500 in Thailand today at 08:39, using your card ending 4821.

If you made this purchase, confirm it below. If you did not make this purchase, use the button below to cancel the transaction.

Nova Bank Security
case01.mail.digest.subject: Your weekly security digest
case01.mail.digest.preview: Three short ways to keep your accounts safer this week.
case01.mail.digest.body: This week's reminder: slow down when a message creates urgency. Verify unexpected requests using contact details you found independently.

case01.mail.energy.preview: Your latest energy statement is now available.
case01.mail.energy.body: Your September energy statement is ready. Your direct debit remains unchanged, so no action is required.
tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Trust Protocol
tutorial.welcome.body: This is a simulated computer. Everything you see belongs to the fictional investigation—no real banking details or external services are used.
tutorial.desktop.title: Your desktop is the investigation space
tutorial.desktop.body: Select an application icon to open it. Windows can be dragged, minimized, restored from the taskbar, or closed without removing the application.
tutorial.compare.title: Verify before you act
tutorial.compare.body: Messages can sound convincing. Use different applications to compare names, addresses and claims. The game will respond to what you inspect and what you choose to do.
day01.call.suspicious.intro: Hello, Nova Bank security. Our risk control department has detected an unusual €14,500 transaction in Thailand. Did you make this transaction?
day01.call.suspicious.instruction: We have sent a confirmation email. You can approve or cancel the transaction in that email. Thank you. Goodbye.
day01.call.suspicious.nagOne: The email contains the transaction details. Have you found the cancellation button?
day01.call.suspicious.nagTwo: Open Mail and select the message from Nova Bank Security. Use the cancellation button in that message.
day01.call.police.stop: **Wait!!** This is the police. Do not continue with that link or provide any personal information.
day01.call.police.explanation: Wait! Pause before following the caller’s instructions. We are investigating reports of people posing as bank staff and sending device-review links. Do not send personal details. End the call and contact your bank through a channel you already know. This warning does not check or secure your account for you.
d1.restart.title: Start Day 1 again?
d1.restart.body: This replaces your current Day 1 progress. Your language preference stays unchanged.
d1.storage: Progress could not be saved. You can keep playing in this tab.
d1.corrupt: The saved session could not be restored. A new Day 1 has started.
d1.browser.intro: Your usual places. These bookmarks were saved before today’s messages arrived.
d1.fake.title: Confirm your device
d1.bank.title: Your account
linear.police.leak: We are investigating a group impersonating bank staff. They already have some people's names, email addresses and phone numbers — including yours. This information was exposed before today's call. Clicking that link did not cause the earlier leak.
linear.police.method: For uncertain messages, **search for Nova in your browser** and find the bank’s website, or **open the bank app to check your transactions**. Do not rely only on the contact details in the email.
linear.police.mark: You can **forward suspicious emails to us**. Choose **one reason** for your report. We will call you back after reviewing it.
linear.website.title: Recognising messages from Nova
linear.website.body: For this fictional bank, all customer notification emails use the exact domain below. A name or logo is not proof of origin. Contact us through this saved website if anything remains unclear.
linear.record: Record domain and return to Mail
linear.recorded: Domain recorded. Compare it with the full sender address in Mail.
linear.inspect: Expand the sender address to compare it with your website reference.
linear.reason.domain: The sender domain differs from the bank's published domain
linear.reason.retry: Urgency is a reason to pause. What concrete mismatch can you document here?
linear.playtest: End of this playtest. Day 2 is not available yet.
linear.bank: No action is required on your account today.

report.reason.domain: Sender address differs from official details
report.feedback.domain: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. The sender uses nova-alerts.net. Nova confirmed that its customer emails use novabank.nl. Your report correctly identifies the mismatch.
report.reason.transaction: Transaction details differ from account records
report.feedback.transaction: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. Nova confirmed there is no matching €14,500 purchase or pending payment. Your report correctly identifies the false transaction claim.
report.reason.password: Requests a password or verification code
report.feedback.password: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. The email is fraudulent, but it does not ask for a password or code. That reason does not describe the email you forwarded.
report.reason.transfer: Requests a transfer to a specified account
report.feedback.transfer: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. The email is fraudulent, but it asks you to cancel a transaction, not transfer money. That reason does not match this message.
report.reason.software: Requests software installation or remote access
report.feedback.software: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. The email is fraudulent, but contains no request to install software or allow remote access. That reason does not match this message.
report.reason.identity: Impersonates a friend with inconsistent identity details
report.feedback.identity: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. This sender impersonates a bank, not a friend. The email is fraudulent, but the selected reason does not describe this case.
report.reason.pressure: Uses a deadline or threats to demand action
report.feedback.pressure: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. The email is fraudulent, but gives no deadline or threat. Its main deception is the invented purchase. Your selected reason does not match the wording.
report.reason.url: Link address differs from the official website
report.feedback.url: This is the police, calling about your forwarded email. Our review confirmed that the cancellation link leads outside Nova’s website. Your reported reason matches our findings.
